Announcement Description
The   project  “Building Climate Resilience   of  Communities   in  Cambodia’s Protected Landscapes: Biodiversity-Friendly Crop-Livestock Systems   for  Adaptation (SCALE+)”, implemented by Ministry   of  Environment (MoE)   and  Ministry   of  Agriculture, Forestry   and  Fisheries (MAFF)   in  partnership   with  the Food   and  Agriculture Organization   of  the United Nations (FAO)   and  funded by   the  Global Environment Facility (GEF),   is  seeking qualified   candidates  for   the  following positions:

Position Summary 		   Duration   of  work
Working closely   with  the Finance &   Operations  team,   project  team   and  under   the  management   of  the Admin & Finance Specialist   and  National   Project  Manager   at  SCALE+ project.
Duty Station
The incumbent   will  be   based  at   the  Ministry   of  Environment,   with  travel   to  the provinces   as  required. Transportation costs   and  Daily Subsistence   Allowance  (DSA)   for  official field assignments   will  be covered by   the  project   in  accordance   with  project regulations.
The  Admin & Finance Intern    will  assist day to-day   office  finance   and  administration, logistics,   and  procurement support, including   but  not limited   to  the SCALE+   project  in Cambodia.   This  position   will  be   based  in Phnom Penh.
Duties & Responsibilities:
•  Assist   with  day-to-day financial   and  administrative operations, including filing, scanning, photocopying,   and  maintaining proper documentation.
•  Assist   in  processing   project  financial transactions   and  ensure   all  supporting documents   are  complete, properly filed,   and  comply   with  project procedures.
•  Provide logistical   support  for field missions, including preparing DSA requests, arranging transportation, booking accommodation,   and  coordinating travel logistics.
•  Assist   in  organizing workshops, meetings, consultations,   and  training events, including venue setup, participant registration, attendance lists, refreshments, meeting materials,   and  DSA distribution where applicable.
•  Provide administrative   and  logistical   support  to both   the  Operations   and  Technical Teams   for  project   activities  and events.
•  Assist   in  maintaining   office  inventory   and  the fixed asset register,   and  support periodic physical inventory verification.
•  Assist   in  preparing routine financial, administrative,   and  procurement reports, spreadsheets,   and  document tracking records.
•  Maintain both electronic   and  hard-copy filing systems   to  ensure   project  documents   are  well organized   and  easily accessible.
•  Support correspondence, document preparation,   and  other administrative tasks   as  requested by   the  project team.
•  Perform other finance, administration, logistics, procurement,   and  operational duties   as  assigned by   the  supervisor.
Benefits:
•  Transportation costs   and  Daily Subsistence   Allowance  (DSA)   for  official field assignments   will  be covered by   the  project   in  accordance   with  project regulations.
Expected Profile of Candidates
Languages:
•   English  - Good
•   Khmer  - Good
Qualifications:
•  Bachelor's Degree   in  In accounting, finance,   or  other relevant degree
•  Undergraduate Degree
Skills & Knowledge:
General & Technical Skills
•  Available   for  non-experienced   or  experienced.
•  Self-motivated   with  a willingness   to  learn   and  gain   more  skills   in  accounting, procurement, operations,   and  logistics   and  in   development  projects.
•  Demonstrated knowledge   of  Microsoft   Office  (Microsoft Word, Excel).
Soft Skills
•  Willingness   to  learn   and  take initiative.
•  Good organizational   and  time management skills.
•  Attention   to  detail   and  accuracy.
•  Responsible, honest,   and  reliable.
•  Good interpersonal   and  communication skills.
•  Ability   to  work effectively   in  a team.
•  Ability   to  maintain confidentiality when handling   project  documents.
How to Apply
Interested   candidates  are invited   to  submit   a  CV   and  Cover Letter, clearly stating   the  subject line, about your   position  of interest. Please   send  your   application  to   email  provided   in  the   contact  details. Applications   will  be reviewed   on  a rolling basis. Only shortlisted   applicants  will   be  contacted.
Detailed Terms   of  Reference (TOR)   for  each   position  are available   in  the document below.
